# General Requirements Quality Checklist: Entrada y Gestión de Texto (FR-01)

**Purpose**: Validación general de completitud, claridad, consistencia y cobertura de los requisitos de `spec.md` antes de avanzar a QA/implementación
**Created**: 2026-08-26
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are requirements defined for what happens when the text area receives focus but no text has ever been entered (initial empty state)? [Gap, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements defined for the visible label/placeholder (if any) of the main text area? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for the visible label of the "Vaciar" action (exact wording, icon presence)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for what happens to focus after the "Vaciar" action executes (e.g., does focus return to the text area)? [Gap, Spec §FR-003, FR-004]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for how the MAIN CONTENT region relates spatially/structurally to the rest of the page layout it will sit inside (Topbar/Sidebar/Footer)? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is "en tiempo real" (FR-002) quantified with a specific latency or perceptibility threshold? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, SC-001]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "de forma inmediata" (FR-004) quantified, or is it clear that it means synchronous/no perceptible delay? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "extremadamente largo" in the edge case for large pastes quantified with an approximate character/line count? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "disposición clara y utilizable" (FR-007, SC-004) defined with objective, measurable criteria (e.g., no horizontal scroll, minimum touch target size)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, SC-004]
- [ ] CHK010 Are "roles y etiquetas accesibles" (FR-008) tied to a specific accessibility standard or guideline (e.g., WCAG level) to make the requirement testable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Are the terms used for the main input area ("área de texto", "área de trabajo", "área principal") used consistently across User Stories, Functional Requirements, and Success Criteria? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK012 Are the terms used for the clear action ("vaciar", "acción de vaciar") consistent between User Story 2, FR-003/FR-004, and SC-002? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK013 Do the keyboard-operability requirements in FR-005 and User Story 3's acceptance scenarios describe the same expected behavior without contradiction? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, US3]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK014 Can SC-001 ("menos de 1 segundo") be objectively measured without referencing implementation details? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK015 Can SC-003 ("100% de los controles... alcanzables y operables usando solo el teclado") be verified with a concrete, repeatable procedure? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK016 Is SC-004's claim of "sin solapamientos" tied to specific viewport widths or breakpoints that would need to be checked? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK017 Does every acceptance scenario in User Stories 1–3 map to at least one functional requirement or success criterion? [Traceability]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK018 Are requirements defined for the primary flow (typing/pasting free text) as well as the alternate flow (clearing) and the exception-like flow (clearing an already-empty area)? [Coverage, Spec §US1, US2]
- [ ] CHK019 Are requirements defined for concurrent or rapid repeated interactions (e.g., double-activating "Vaciar" quickly) beyond the single edge case already listed? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK020 Are non-functional (accessibility, responsive layout) scenarios addressed with the same rigor as functional scenarios (entry/clear)? [Coverage, Spec §US3]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements defined for pasting content that includes non-text data (e.g., rich text/HTML) into the text area? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements defined for extremely long single-line (no line breaks) pasted text, as distinct from long multi-line text? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the "solo espacios o saltos de línea" edge case's expected behavior fully specified for the clear action as well as for entry? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK024 Are responsive design requirements (FR-007) specific enough to identify target breakpoints (mobile/tablet/desktop) referenced by `docs/product-requirements.md`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK025 Are accessibility requirements (FR-008) specific enough to cover screen-reader announcement content, not just keyboard reachability? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the zero-network requirement (FR-009) explicit about what "gestión del texto" includes (e.g., no analytics/telemetry calls either)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK027 Is the assumption that "no character limit applies in this spec" validated against the rest of `docs/product-requirements.md` to confirm no conflicting global limit exists? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the assumption that no confirmation dialog is needed before clearing validated against user-safety expectations for potentially destructive actions? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the dependency on a future page layout (Topbar/Sidebar/Footer) that will host this MAIN CONTENT region documented anywhere outside the Assumptions section (e.g., cross-referenced from a layout spec)? [Dependency, Gap]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK030 Is there any ambiguity between FR-001 ("sin restricciones de formato") and the Assumptions section regarding whether pasted rich text should be auto-converted to plain text? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-001, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK031 Is there a documented requirement & acceptance criteria ID scheme distinguishing functional requirements (FR-xxx) from success criteria (SC-xxx) consistently, to support traceability in future specs? [Traceability]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
